summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Race Configuration parametric refactor for Backyard Ultra Santo Domingo 2026. All 21 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI tests verified dynamic race info on homepage, results page, community page, and admin panel with 3 tabs (Panel de Control, Encuestas, Carrera Activa).
critical_code_review_comments: Race config endpoints correctly exclude MongoDB _id from responses using projection {'_id': 0}
JWT authentication properly protects create/update/activate endpoints
RaceConfigContext correctly fetches active race config and provides helper functions (getYear, getShortDate, getRaceStartDate)
Components (Navigation, Hero, LiveDashboard, ComunidadPage) correctly use useRaceConfig() hook for dynamic values
Admin panel RaceConfigPanel allows viewing and editing race configuration with proper form validation
seed_data_creation: Created test race during testing: TEST-{uuid} with is_active=false
context_for_next_testing_agent: Race configuration system fully functional. Endpoints: GET /api/race-config/active (public), GET /api/race-config/all (public), GET /api/race-config/{code} (public), POST /api/race-config/create (JWT auth), PUT /api/race-config/update/{code} (JWT auth), POST /api/race-config/activate/{code} (JWT auth). Frontend: RaceConfigContext provides global race config. Admin panel at /admin has 3 tabs: Panel de Control, Encuestas, Carrera Activa. Active race is BYSD-2026.
